newsitem.title: USA: Occidental oil & gas unit posts Q4 profit.
newsitem.headline: Occidental oil & gas unit posts Q4 profit.

text.p: Occidental Petroleum Corp said on Thursday that its oil and gas unit posted a $155 million profit in the fourth quarter, compared to a loss of $31 million the previous fourth quarter.
Occidental reported fourth quarter earnings of $0.41 a share, compared to a $0.05 a share loss the year before.
Total divisional earnings for the quarter were $340 million versus $158 million for the year earlier quarter.
Chemicals earned $110 million in the quarter, down from $167 million fourth quarter last year. Natural gas transmission earned $75 million versus $22 million in the fourth quarter.
